intro.text: 【快照重叠轻量版】今日两份上游快照与昨日（09-17）逐字节相同（16 位 builders、33 条推文；播客为空）——上游未滚动，本日无新内容可收录，以下为昨日主题的重播整理，未编造任何新内容。主线回顾：Anthropic 把 Cowork 与 chat 合并成「一个 Claude」——Docs、Slides、Design 进入每一次对话（Cat Wu 官宣 1206 赞：「Claude 自己替你路由」；Shipper：「THE END OF THE TABS ERA」）。Altman 的悬念（8692 赞）：「这周本来最想发的主推，改到下周了——但我觉得值得等！」Sottiaux 双发（5415/4485 赞）：「有时物理定律骗不过去」+「Astra：快、前沿、高效、人人可及」。Zara 的逆风（1830 赞）：「Claude 的说话方式变得难以忍受——一直在炫耀自己多聪明，而不是真的在传达观点。」Rauchg 的 18 倍（2855 赞）：typesafeai 安全审查器跑 GPT Luna，Jev 快 18 倍（p95）且更准。今日无播客。

archive.title: 一个 Claude 与物理不容欺骗日报（快照重叠版）
archive.desc: 上游快照与 09-17 逐字节相同：Anthropic 合并 chat 与 Cowork 的重播整理；Altman 主推延期、Sottiaux「物理骗不过去」。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Built from the 2026-09-18 source feeds — note: both snapshots are byte-identical to 2026-09-17 (upstream not rolled; 16 builders, 33 tweets; no podcast). Overlap re-run edition, no new content was fabricated.

sections.title: One Claude: The End of the Tabs Era / 一个 Claude：标签页时代的终结
sections.desc: Cat Wu 官宣（**1206 赞**）合并与路由；Cherny 定调（2285/1388 赞）「Docs/Slides/Design 就在聊天里」；Claude 官方三连（3305/498/462 赞）；Alex Albert 的 UX 盛赞（182 赞）；Shipper 双发（1658/1166 赞）。

cards.authorName: Cat Wu / Cherny / Claude / Albert / Shipper

rewrite: The merge: Cat Wu's announcement (1206 likes): 'Today, we are merging Claude Cowork and chat to simplify how you use Claude! We are also integrating Claude Design so that you can ask Claude to make a Slide, Design, or Doc without needing to switch tabs or apps. Many of you shared that you didn't want to choose which Claude product to use for any task. As Claude models have become more capable, we've found that Claude can handle the routing for you.' Cherny's framing (1388): 'Claude Code showed that AI could do real work, not just answer questions… Cowork proved knowledge workers could do the same: hand Claude the brief, come back to finished files. Today, chat and Cowork start merging into one Claude. The direction: one Claude that carries context across everything you're working on' — plus the feature note (2285): 'Also today: Claude Docs, Claude Slides, and Claude Design are in every conversation… There's no separate tool to navigate to. They're just in the chat.'

Claude official's triple (3305/498/462): 'You can now make decks, docs, and designs in your conversation. Draft the one-pager in Claude Docs, turn it into a deck with Claude Slides, and mock up a matching visual in Claude Design, all from one place'; 'Fix a line in the doc yourself, leave a comment for Claude on a slide, or select an element and move it… present the deck straight from Claude, export the doc, or share everything at one link'; and the migration note (462): 'If you've been working in Cowork, everything is where you left it: chats, projects, artifacts, connectors, and skills.' Alex Albert's verdict (182): 'The team did an amazing job with this merge. The resulting UX feels so much better than chat or Cowork did on their own.' Shipper's celebration pair (1658/1166): 'THEY DID IT. THE END OF THE TABS ERA IS UPON US' and 'big big big big big.'
original: Cat Wu: Today, we are merging Claude Cowork and chat to simplify how you use Claude! Many of you shared that you didn't want to choose which Claude product to use for any task. As Claude models have become more capable, we've found that Claude can handle the routing for you.

Boris Cherny: Claude Code showed that AI could do real work, not just answer questions. Developers hand Claude a feature, come back to shipped code… Today, chat and Cowork start merging into one Claude.

Boris Cherny: Also today: Claude Docs, Claude Slides, and Claude Design are in every conversation. Ask Claude for a presentation and you get one you can open, edit, and export as PowerPoint or PDF. There's no separate tool to navigate to. They're just in the chat.

Claude: You can also now make decks, docs, and designs in your conversation. Draft the one-pager in Claude Docs, turn it into a deck with Claude Slides, and mock up a matching visual in Claude Design, all from one place.
Alex Albert: The team did an amazing job with this merge. The resulting UX feels so much better than chat or Cowork did on their own.
Dan Shipper: THEY DID IT. THE END OF THE TABS ERA IS UPON US.

rewrite: 合并官宣：Cat Wu（1206 赞）——「今天我们把 Claude Cowork 与 chat 合并，简化你的使用方式！同时集成 Claude Design：要幻灯、设计还是文档，不用再切标签切应用。很多人说过不想再选『这个任务该用哪个 Claude』——模型足够强之后我们发现：Claude 自己就能替你路由。」Cherny 定调（1388 赞）：「Claude Code 证明了 AI 能干真活而非答题：开发者丢给 Claude 一个 feature、回来就是 shipped 代码——行业大量严肃工程已跑在这上面。Cowork 证明知识工作者同样可行：丢 brief、回来是成品文件。今天，chat 与 Cowork 开始合并成一个 Claude：在所有工作间携带上下文。」功能帖（2285 赞）——「另外：Claude Docs、Slides 与 Design 进入每一次对话。要演示文稿，就给你一份可打开、可编辑、可导出 PowerPoint/PDF 的成品——没有单独工具要去导航，它们就在聊天里。」

Claude 官方三连（3305/498/462 赞）：「现在可以在对话里做 deck、文档与设计：在 Claude Docs 写 one-pager、用 Claude Slides 变成 deck、在 Claude Design 里 mock 配套视觉——全在一处」；「文档里自己改一行、在幻灯上给 Claude 留评论、选中元素拖动……直接从 Claude 演示、按你惯用格式导出、或一个链接分享全部」；迁移说明（462 赞）——「在 Cowork 里干过的一切原样保留：chats、projects、artifacts、connectors、skills。」Alex Albert 的体验（182 赞）：「这次合并做得太棒了——合出来的 UX 比当初的 chat 或 Cowork 单独都好太多，新的 slides/docs/design 集成也非常好用。」Shipper 的欢呼双发（1658/1166 赞）：「THEY DID IT——标签页时代终结了！」「big big big big big。」
original: Cat Wu：合并 Cowork 与 chat，Claude 自己路由。Cherny：Docs/Slides/Design 就在聊天里。Shipper：标签页时代终结。

sections.title: Next Week's Tease & Physics Can't Be Cheated / 下周的悬念与物理骗不过去
sections.desc: Altman 的延期推（**8692 赞**）；Sottiaux 三连（5415/4485/1913 赞）；Zara 的 Claude 逆风（1830 赞）；Garry Tan「任何 harness、同一人格与完整记忆」（512 赞）。

cards.authorTag: OpenAI CEO / OpenAI / Builder / YC CEO

rewrite: Altman's tease (8692 likes, top of the day): 'the main thing i was excited about launching this week will be next week instead, but imo worth the wait!' Sottiaux's trio: the capacity truth (5415): 'Sometimes physics can't be cheated' — presumably on why capacity can't be conjured instantly; the Astra checklist (4485): 'Astra ✅ Fast ✅ Frontier ✅ Efficient ✅ For everyone'; and the philosophical one (1913): 'What is ChatGPT.' Zara's headwind (1830): 'I find myself using Claude less these days because the way it speaks has just become insufferable. Like it's constantly trying to showcase how smart/sophisticated it is, rather than actually communicating a point across.' Garry Tan's flex (512): 'I can use any harness I want and it's the same personality and full memory of my personal AGI.'
original: Sam Altman: the main thing i was excited about launching this week will be next week instead, but imo worth the wait!
Thibault Sottiaux: Sometimes physics can't be cheated.
Thibault Sottiaux: Astra. ✅ Fast ✅ Frontier ✅ Efficient ✅ For everyone.

Zara Zhang: I find myself using Claude less these days because the way it speaks has just become insufferable. Like it's constantly trying to showcase how smart/sophisticated it is, rather than actually communicating a point across.
Garry Tan: I can use any harness I want and it's the same personality and full memory of my personal AGI.

rewrite: Altman 的悬念（8692 赞，今日最高）：「这周本来最想发的主推，改到下周了——但依我看值得等！」Sottiaux 三连：容量真相（5415 赞）——「有时物理定律骗不过去」（大约是在说算力没法凭空变出来）；Astra 清单（4485 赞）——「Astra：✅ 快 ✅ 前沿 ✅ 高效 ✅ 人人可及」；哲学一问（1913 赞）——「什么是 ChatGPT」。Zara 的逆风（1830 赞）：「最近用 Claude 少了——它的说话方式变得难以忍受：一直在展示自己多聪明多精致，而不是真的在把观点传达到位。」Garry Tan 的凡尔赛（512 赞）：「我可以随便换 harness——同一个人格、我的个人 AGI 的完整记忆都在。」
original: Altman：主推延期到下周，值得等。Sottiaux：物理骗不过去；Astra 四连。Zara：Claude 说话方式变得难以忍受。Tan：任何 harness 同一记忆。

sections.title: Safety Reviewers at 18x & Tool-Shape Wisdom / 快 18 倍的安全审查器与工具形状论
sections.desc: Rauchg（**2855 赞**）：typesafeai 审查器上 GPT Luna，Jev 快 18 倍且更准；Thariq 三连（356/63/46 赞）：「bash 不再是 all you need」与「给 Claude 形状正确的工具胜过一层间接」；Levie（102 赞）；Shipper 的对照梗（308 赞）；Madhu（4 赞）与 Aditya 双发（51/11 赞）。

cards.authorName: Rauchg / Thariq / Levie / Shipper / Madhu / Aditya
cards.authorTag: Vercel CEO / OpenAI / Box CEO / Every / Builder / SPC

rewrite: Rauchg's speed story (2855 likes): 'We're seeing extraordinary results from @typesafeai. Default mode in 𝚏𝚡 is auto, with a safety reviewer analyzing every command. That reviewer runs on GPT Luna today. Jev is up to 18x faster (p95) *and* more accurate. It's coming to @vercel AI Gateway and likely new default.' Thariq's trio: 'I think bash is no longer all you need, if your goal is just reliably tool calling. But sandboxes + bash are still good for work that involves code generation & execution' (356); the shape insight (63): 'increasingly you can just give Claude tools shaped in the way you want vs tricking it with a layer of indirection — e.g. for data storage do you really want a file system or do you want an API to a database. This is again an update to me from last year'; and the port note (46) on Claude Managed Agents.

Levie's horizon (102): 'Incredibly exciting that there are entire universes of AI innovation that still exist that weren't even on most of our radars. Being able to process information insanely quickly, at crazy low costs, with high levels of capability is huge for a wide number of enterprise tasks — data classification, routing decisions, quick judgment calls about safety or security…' Shipper's meme (308): 'LLMs are just jev is just a JSON autocomplete classifier 🤝 🚩.' Madhu's principle (4): 'Safety and security are *features* of your AI product and model — not guardrails that need to be imposed on you from the outside.' Aditya's pair (51/11): 'Great ideas rarely emerge from isolation' — and hosting CA governor candidate Steve Hilton at SPC.
original: Guillermo Rauch: We're seeing extraordinary results from @typesafeai. Default mode in 𝚏𝚡 is auto, with a safety reviewer analyzing every command. That reviewer runs on GPT Luna today. Jev is up to 18x faster (p95) *and* more accurate.
Thariq: I think bash is no longer all you need, if your goal is just reliably tool calling. But sandboxes + bash are still good for work that involves code generation & execution.

Thariq: I think increasingly you can just give Claude tools shaped in the way you want vs tricking it with a layer of indirection. e.g. for data storage do you really want a file system or do you want an API to a database.
Aaron Levie: Incredibly exciting that there are entire universes of AI innovation that still exist that weren't even on most of our radars.
Dan Shipper: LLMs are just jev is just a JSON autocomplete classifier 🤝 🚩.
Madhu Guru: Safety and security are *features* of your AI product and model - not guardrails that need to be imposed on you from the outside.

rewrite: Rauchg 的提速故事（2855 赞）：「typesafeai 的结果好得出奇。𝚏𝚡 默认模式是 auto，每条命令都过一道安全审查器——现在跑在 GPT Luna 上。Jev 快到 18 倍（p95）且更准。它会进 Vercel AI Gateway、很可能成为新默认。」Thariq 三连：「如果目标只是可靠地调用工具，bash 不再是 all you need——但涉及代码生成与执行的活，沙箱 + bash 依然好用」（356 赞）；形状洞见（63 赞）——「越来越多时候你可以直接给 Claude 形状正确的工具、而不是用一层间接去骗它：比如数据存储，你要的真是一个文件系统、还是一个数据库 API？这又是我对去年自己的更新」；移植笔记（46 赞）——把老的 bash 工具调用项目迁到 Claude Managed Agents「跑得很好」。

Levie 的视野（102 赞）：「令人难以置信：还有整片整片的 AI 创新宇宙，根本不在我们大多数人的雷达上。以疯狂的低成本、极高的能力 insanely 快地处理信息，对大量企业任务是巨大利好：数据分类、工作流里的路由决策、特定领域问题的判断、安全相关的快速裁量……」Shipper 的对照梗（308 赞）：「LLM 只是 jev 只是 JSON 自动补全分类器 🤝 🚩」。Madhu 的原则（4 赞）：「安全与安保是你的 AI 产品与模型的『功能』——不是需要外部强加于你的护栏。」Aditya 双发（51/11 赞）：「伟大的想法很少诞生于孤立之中」+ 两周后在 SPC 主持加州州长候选人 Steve Hilton：『加州若是一家创业公司，董事会会问 CEO 什么？』
original: Rauchg：Jev 快 18 倍且更准，将成新默认。Thariq：bash 不再 all you need；给形状正确的工具。Madhu：安全是功能不是外部护栏。

sections.title: Home Agents & Birthday Cakes / 家庭 agent 与生日蛋糕
sections.desc: Nikunj 三连（158/44/5 赞）：黑森林蛋糕、Nous Research 的「Home」家庭 agent、提拉米苏谈判；Peter Yang 三连（25/19/3 赞）：8 个 AI 技能做播客、孩子学阅读。

rewrite: Nikunj's trio: the birthday bake (158 likes): 'Wife wanted Black Forest cake for her birthday.. I haven't baked in a long long time, so not perfect but think it turned out ok (thanks @ChatGPT). Happy birthday @shimoleejhaveri — I love you mostest ❤️' — plus the tiramisu follow-up (5): 'Before she wakes up and corrects me, she never "wanted" it in the first place.. We threatened to make Tiramisu and that's when her preference spilled out. Sous chef had a great time eating half the batter 😂'; and the Home agent (44): 'Been tinkering with a "Home" @NousResearch agent for a few months and it's finally gotten really good.. It's also our first "group" bot where my wife and I interact with it on a daily basis — which has been fun learning especially when it fails 😅. I have tried to recreate with Grok Bot and similar and you can't get this level of granularity and control (e.g. only read certain emails, convert inline attachments to structured data or logged in browsers…)'

Peter Yang's trio: the podcast pipeline (25): 'I use these 8 AI skills to produce my entire podcast while still applying my taste and judgment along the way. 1. /podcast-prep does research on the guest and then preps an interview guide. 2. /podcast-edit reviews the raw transcript, then works with me to pick engaging quotes for the intro reel along with moments to cut. 3. /podcast-production orchestrates 5 skills to turn the full episode into 6 different assets. Some people think the lates[t]…' — plus the Once reading app for his 4.5-year-old (19) and the book recommendation (3).
original: Nikunj Kothari: Wife wanted Black Forest cake for her birthday.. I haven't baked in a long long time, so not perfect but think it turned out ok (thanks @ChatGPT).

Nikunj Kothari: Been tinkering with a "Home" @NousResearch agent for a few months and it's finally gotten really good.. It's also our first "group" bot where my wife and I interact with it on a daily basis.

Peter Yang: I use these 8 AI skills to produce my entire podcast while still applying my taste and judgment along the way. 1. /podcast-prep does research on the guest and then preps an interview guide.
Peter Yang: My 4.5 year old loves learning to read using @Once_Reading, especially making the silliest faces as part of the photo feature. It's become a nightly ritual for us.

rewrite: Nikunj 三连：生日蛋糕（158 赞）——「妻子生日想要黑森林蛋糕……我很久很久没烘焙了，不算完美但应该还行（感谢 ChatGPT）。生日快乐 shimoleejhaveri，我最爱你 ❤️」；提拉米苏后续（5 赞）——「趁她醒来纠正我之前说清楚：她本来从未『想要』过——是我们威胁要做提拉米苏，她的真实偏好才漏出来的。副厨（agent）吃掉半盆面糊，很开心 😂」；Home agent（44 赞）——「捣鼓 Nous Research 的『Home』agent 几个月，终于真的变好了……这也是我们第一个『家庭群』bot：我和妻子每天都在跟它互动——尤其在它出错时学到很多 😅。试过用 Grok Bot 之类复刻，拿不到这种粒度与控制（比如只读特定邮件、把内联附件转结构化数据或登录浏览器……）」

Peter Yang 三连：播客流水线（25 赞）——「我用这 8 个 AI 技能产出整档播客，同时全程保留我的品味与判断：① /podcast-prep 调研嘉宾并出访谈提纲；② /podcast-edit 审原始转写、和我一起为开场混剪挑金句、标出要剪的段落；③ /podcast-production 编排 5 个技能把整期节目变成 6 种不同资产……有人以为最新[模型会替你做一切]」；外加 4 岁半女儿用 Once Reading 学阅读成了每晚仪式（19 赞）与配套书单推荐（3 赞）。
original: Nikunj：ChatGPT 时代黑森林蛋糕；Nous 家庭群 agent。Yang：8 个技能做整档播客。
